headline: Callahan's Passage and Weathered Expanse Churn as Island Clashes Deepen
war_summary: In the three hours since our last dispatch, violent base churn has reignited along Callahan's Passage, recording eight fresh turnovers in the past two hours alone centered on The Crumbling Passage and Scáth Passing amidst nearly two thousand casualties. Weathered Expanse persists as the war's most tempestuous sector, lodging nine transfers in the two-hour window to surpass fifty events over the day as Frostmarch and Crow's Nest trade hands. Naval and island friction has broadened significantly: Fisherman's Row sustained ten rapid base handovers across Eidolo, Black Well, and Oceanwatch, while southern waters around Stema Landing erupted with four transitions over The Flair and The Wane. To the northwest, Nevish Line broke into fresh movement at Grief Mother alongside severe attritional bloodletting exceeding two thousand casualties in two hours. By contrast, the fierce clashes recently reported in Palantine Berm have abruptly cooled to a crawl, and Mooring County has held its perimeter without fresh base captures despite persistent, heavy exchanges of fire.
